name: termecon
label: Worry about economic burden of terminal illness

questions.text:
Now, I would like to talk about concerns you may have when considering what may happen at the end of your life. please tell me how much you agree or disagree with each of these statements: 
A. I worry about the economic burden that a terminal illness might cause my family.
questions.stem: Now, I would like to talk about concerns you may have when considering what may happen at the end of your life. please tell me how much you agree or disagree with each of these statements:
questions.item: A. I worry about the economic burden that a terminal illness might cause my family.

name: termpay
label: Worry if no money get second class care
